report_discrepancies.note: Statement of Activities (p2) and Statement of Net Position (p1) print business-type ending net position 1,299,681,369, while the proprietary funds statement (p11) prints 1,299,681,366; on p2, beginning after restatement 1,207,678,547 + change 92,002,819 = 1,299,681,366, not the printed 1,299,681,369 (total column change 169,359,618 vs 77,356,796 + 92,002,819 = 169,359,615). business_type uses the p11 figures, which roll forward exactly.
Cable Access Television Fund budget schedule: actual expenditure lines 25,920 + 787 + 43,528 + 97,987 = 168,222, printed Total Expenditures 168,221 (rounding in the report).

Lincoln City Libraries Fund budget schedule: actual expenditure lines 7,281,719 + 167,428 + 1,862,495 + 792,806 = 10,104,448, printed Total Expenditures 10,104,447 (the printed excess 335,489 agrees with the lines; rounding in the report).

notes: GAAP. Governmental: Total column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p4); beginning 418,321,556 + revenues 439,394,349 - expenditures 428,909,346 + transfers in 92,868,782 - transfers out 81,395,952 + other financing 508,893 = ending 440,788,282. ending_cash = cash and cash equivalents from the governmental funds Balance Sheet Total column (p3), investments 459,924,423 in ending_investments for information; beginning cash not shown. other_financing = Leases Issued 93,718 + Sale of Capital Assets 415,175; no debt issued. Statement 'Debt Service' and 'Debt Service P & I' lines are not split by principal/interest on p4 (debt service (principal and interest combined)); the statement 'Capital Outlay' line prints no function. Investment Loss lines are negative as printed. Business-type: Total enterprise column of the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position (p11), internal service funds excluded; no single total printed, so totals = operating + nonoperating lines (negative nonoperating expense lines shown as positive expenses; negative Investment Earnings (Loss) kept as a negative receipt); other_financing = capital contributions less plant costs recovered; GASB 87 adjustment (100,581) recorded as business_type.restatement. Proprietary cash flows p12 Total column. governmental_net_position from the Statement of Activities (p2; governmental GASB 87 adjustment is '-'). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), Governmental and Business-type columns per line, totals from the Total column. Detail (same approach as Lincoln_FY2023/FY2024): General, Street Construction, West Haymarket JPA and Federal Grants funds from the p4 fund columns, so detail ties to p4; the budget-basis schedules for those funds (p5 General, p6 Street Construction, pp7-8 Federal Grants), the General Fund combining schedule (p14) and the General Fund sub-fund budget schedules (pp15-18: Athletic Field & Facilities Improvement, Lincoln Area Agency on Aging, 911 Communication, Unemployment Compensation) cover the same money and are not used. This trim has no nonmajor combining statements, so nonmajor funds come from their own printed budget-and-actual schedules (budget basis, Actual column, final budget in budget_final): Cable Access Television (p19), Lincoln City Libraries (p20), Lincoln/Lancaster County Health (p21), Social Security (p22), StarTran (p23), Keno (p24), Building & Safety (p25), Library Special Trust (p26), Lincoln Bike Share (p27), Tax Allocation Projects (p28), Bond Interest & Redemption (p29), Tax Supported Bonds (p30), Community Health Permanent Endowment (p31); other nonmajor funds (capital projects etc.) have no schedule in the trim. Dash actual cells omitted; '-' budget cells recorded as 0, blank budget cells as null. Personal Services -> salaries and wages, Other Services and Charges -> professional/contract services (broad group, review). No business-type detail (no enterprise fund schedules in the trim). Pages 32-34 are statistical tables (no figures used). Read pages 1-34 of 34
